title: GovernanceResultReceptor
description: Identifies the receptor that receives governance results. The framework reference defines which governance domain consumes evaluation outcomes. Source: ITIP Meta-Governance Framework; GSM Receptor semantics.

frameworkRef.description: URI reference identifying the governance framework this receptor consumes results for (e.g., 'gsmarc://frameworks/gdpr/v1'). Defines WHERE governance outcomes are delivered. Identity-bound: receptors of the same Definition always consume results for the same framework. Source: ITIP framework catalog.
